name: YMCA Michigan Youth in Government
what_you_do: Join a school or YMCA delegation. You take part in a student-run model government. There are fall district conferences. There is a big Lansing conference in February or April.
who_can_apply: High school students (a separate middle school program exists). The pages read do not list grades. You join through a school or YMCA delegation.
pay_detail: The base fee is not stated on the page read. A $25 late fee applies to late Lansing registration. A financial aid application is linked on the page.
duration: Fall district conference, then a Lansing conference of about four days
deadline_text: 2026-27: February Lansing conference Feb 18 to 21, 2027, regular registration Nov 10 to Dec 27, late Dec 28 to Jan 13. April Lansing conference Apr 22 to 25, 2027, regular registration Nov 10 to Feb 28, late Mar 1 to 17. Fall district conferences are scheduled Oct 2 to Nov 9, 2026 (registration closes two weeks before each), so some may already be closed.
how_to_apply: Check the map on the YMCA page to see if your school or YMCA has a delegation. If not, use the Contact us page to start one. Then register for the conferences your delegation attends.
notes: Not a job. The deadline_iso is the end of regular registration for the February Lansing conference. Fall conference sites include Marquette, Grayling, Allendale, Saginaw, Kalamazoo and Detroit.
